recall.description: Search past session observations and lessons for relevant context.
recall.prompt: Search for observations and lessons matching the user's query. Call `memory_smart_search` with the query and limit:10, and `memory_lesson_recall` with the query and limit:5. Combine results: group observations by session, show type/title/narrative for each, highlight importance >= 7, show lessons separately with confidence scores. If no results, suggest 2-3 alternative search terms. Never hallucinate results — only present what the MCP tools actually return.
